d: Iran has released new footage showcasing its underground missile facilities, drone stockpiles and weapons assembly lines, signalling that its military capabilities remain intact. The display comes amid fresh threats against the United States, with Tehran warning that any renewed American aggression would invite retaliation without geographical limits. Meanwhile, an Associated Press investigation reveals the extensive damage Iranian strikes have already inflicted on US military bases across West Asia, raising questions about America's military preparedness and the true cost of the conflict.…
